name: Sacramento Buy Nothing
heroLine: See what neighbors are giving — before you join.
description: Community-powered free gifting for Sacramento neighbors. No selling, no bidding, no flipping. 100% free, no ads, ever.

readDetails: Sacramento Buy Nothing is a neighborhood gifting board — not a marketplace. Neighbors post what they are giving away, what they need, or what they would trade. No money changes hands.
Built for Sacramento because this is home. The app runs on Supabase with real-time listings, photos, and messaging. Install as a PWA on Android, tablet, or Chromebook — same account everywhere.
No ads, no data selling, no premium tier. If you use it and want it to stay online, the Support page is there.

For people who care about what is in the glass and who they share a pour with.

Free, ad-free, and meant to be used weekly — not once and forgotten.

readDetails: Friendr is consent-first social connection. Three opt-in layers: Friends, A Bit More, and Way More. You choose how far things go — the app never opts you in.
18+ ID verification before deeper layers unlock. Human moderation, no ads, no data sold. Android PWA plus tablet and Chromebook layouts.
Built as a direct answer to paywalled, ad-driven social apps that treat people as inventory.
